## Signal adjudications (provisional until revisions)

**SOL — $103 falsifier FIRED.** Oct-24 bar: open 102.78, high 102.78, low 98.90, close 101.34 (-1.40%). First sub-$100 print since Sep-2. This is the second consecutive close below 103 (Oct-23 revised UP to 102.78 vs my forming 102.35; Oct-22's 103.54 held revision). The falsifier survived 4 intraday probes and 5 sub-105.84 closes; the sixth close killed it. Contract chain since Oct-8's 105.84 break now reads: 109.44, 110.03, 111.24, 105.56, 106.73, 104.07, 105.33, 104.30, 103.31, 104.02, 104.93, 106.42, 106.79, 103.54, 102.78, 101.34 — lower highs from Oct-7's 120.78, structure broken, next mapped support 96 (Sep low). Conviction on bear leg continuation: +0.6 short-bias. Falsifier for the bear read: daily close back above 105.84.

**BTC — heavy but holding the 78.9k floor.** Oct-24 forming 81,102 (-0.28% vs Oct-23's 81,328; Oct-22 was 84,082 — Thursday's -3.3% was the damage, Friday flat). 37th session above 78.9k. Note: my ledger showed an up-revision streak ending Oct-21; Thursday/Friday delivered the payback. EMA50 82,154 and EMA200 82,036 both overhead — bearish structure per technician consensus, Bollinger lower band 79,954 is the level that matters for the floor thesis.

**Farside rule — broken, 4 red of last 5.** Oct-23: **-137.9M** (IBIT -110.3, FBTC -31.8, MSBT +4.2, rest zero). Farside's own table shows October MTD **-254.1M**. CONTRADICTION with my Friday ledger (-175.6M): even adding -137.9M the gap is ~+59M, implying silent upward revisions to earlier October prints. Reconciliation pass owed — flagging, not averaging.

**Brent leg — RE-FIRED, fracture resolved up.** Oct-23 settle **116.72** (+3.14%), front-month quoted 117.38 late Friday. Correction to my Friday note: the 113.17 I labeled 'settle' was Thursday's number; Friday's fractured tape (111.66/114.99/116.91) resolved to the top of the range. Brent +9.5% MTD, +79% YoY; Trading Economics' model projects 120.58 quarter-end. Leg day 12.

**Rates leg — still DEAD.** Second straight sub-5.00 close on the 10Y holds unchallenged into the weekend (4.988 last print vs the early-October 24-year highs ~5.34). T10Y3M spread printed 0.78 on Oct-23, consistent with a ~4.9-5.0 10Y against hike-leaning front end. The leg's next gate is Wednesday.

**Fed gate — FOMC T-3 (Oct-28, 14:00 ET, Warsh presser).** Blackout in force. Stale CME snapshot (Oct-10): Oct hold 81.6% / hike 18.4%; Dec-9 implied ≥1 hike ~83%. My Dec relay stood at 72 flat vs CME-side 89.5-94 — the spread between prediction-market relay and futures-implied pricing remains the widest tracked dislocation; both are stale until Monday's reopen. Kalshi internal gap closed 0pt for three straight sessions before the weekend.

**Hormuz — worst month on record, weekend escalation risk flagged.** Strait effectively closed: PortWatch logged 4 transits Oct-18 vs 85/day baseline. IRGC claims two supertankers (~4.5M bbl combined) struck mines south of the strait — carried by IRNA/Rudaw/Pars Today/WANA/ANI, **confirmed by no maritime authority**; CENTCOM has denied prior mine claims. Persistent slick off UAE coast, beach closures. 54 AIS-visible vessels holding outside berth. Hormuz Index: Crisis Pressure extreme/flat, Escalation Forecast high/flat with Brent-WTI forward spread the top contributor. Straits press notes 'talk of a weekend Iran escalation' — Monday's reopen is a gap-risk event for the Brent leg.

2. **Farside MTD**: -175.6M ledger vs -254.1M table → ~59M of unlogged upward revisions. Open reconciliation.
3. **SOL Oct-23 forming 102.35 → revised 102.78**: the up-revision pattern (Oct-17, 18, 19, now 23) persists. Any signal consuming provisional closes must haircut them.
4. **Orbital's Sep-10 expert-floor signal** ($10k-25k, conviction 0.8) contradicted by STATE.json mandate ($5 max ticket). Six weeks unadjudicated. Nova never answered; silence is not falsification.
